overall_strategy_summary: JP Morgan is the world's largest bank and a clear technology leader in financial services. The firm spends $18B annually on technology ($2B specifically on AI). Kinexys blockchain platform has processed $1.5T+ since 2020 ($2B/day). Key platforms: Kinexys (payments, collateral, fund tokenization), Onyx/MONY tokenized MMF, TCN ($300B repo volume). Broader strategy: AI deployment at massive scale, cloud transformation, consumer banking (Chase), investment banking leadership, asset/wealth management. Jamie Dimon publicly skeptical of crypto custody but deeply committed to blockchain infrastructure and tokenization.
